shows: RUST (rust-gold mask, black suit) leans over the snooker table, sweeping his hand toward the doorway, jabbing at the lens, shrugging and nodding. A grey-haired old man in a waistcoat chalks his cue on the right, unmoved.
faults: mask turns away and head drops at 0 s and 4 s so the triangle is hidden briefly; otherwise none seen

shows: All six robbers stand in a bunch on a pier wagging raised index fingers in unison, CRIMSON in front in his fedora, then drop the finger to point at the lens. A flat-capped dockworker coils rope behind them.
faults: triangles mostly not readable at this size; MARINE's mask centre reads like a dark eye; one extra unmasked dockworker (intended background)

shows: PLUM, kneeling in shirt and mustard waistcoat, settles his mustard jacket over a shivering old woman's shoulders and rests a hand on her. Her breath clouds in the cold.
faults: no red triangle visible on the plum mask, ring only

shows: SILVER (silver mask, oxblood suit, bow tie) raps at the lens from a low angle: wags a finger, tips his head back, mimes a dainty cake slice, then pushes an open palm into the lens. A small figure with a money bag stands at the top of the steps.
faults: none seen (triangle correct side); hand swells very large near lens at the end

shows: RUST drives an open black roadster across a dry lake bed, white tie whipping, nodding and lifting a gloved hand toward the lens. Two more roadsters race behind in amber dust.
faults: triangle sits near the middle of the face and is hard to read; background drivers too small to check

shows: CRIMSON (fedora, pinstripe), BOTTLE (tweed) and SILVER (oxblood) stand in a blizzard by a headlit sedan, tommy guns held up, nodding and chopping a free hand on the beat.
faults: CRIMSON's triangle not visible (red on red, dark centre reads like a mouth hole); they barely walk forward

shows: On top of a red boxcar BOTTLE drops a sack down to CRIMSON on the ground by a headlit truck, while PLUM and SILVER pump their fists on the roof amid billowing steam.
faults: sack jumps between frames (hangs on the carriage side, then is in his arms); triangles too small to read

shows: A mahogany speedboat races through spray under a searchlight; MARINE in cream drives, CRIMSON in fedora kneels on the stern holding a tommy gun up. City lights behind.
faults: triangles too small to read; none else seen

shows: Police in caps axe whiskey barrels and liquor spreads across the floor, while BOTTLE carries a crate out the back door and SILVER holds the door open.
faults: barrels and spill shift shape between frames; BOTTLE's triangle not readable

shows: MARINE (navy mask, cream linen) flies sideways in slow motion through the banking hall, tommy gun held up, as glass crystals rain from the chandelier behind him.
BOTTLE (green mask, brown tweed) stands in the open window frame of a fallen clapboard house front, Buster Keaton style, brushes dust off his lapel and squares up holding a carpet bag.
faults: no triangle visible; dark centre inside the ring reads like an eye/face hole

shows: PLUM (plum mask, mustard suit) leans on a standing barrel beside split barrels at the back of a truck, deadpan, and gives the lid a pat.
faults: triangle not readable; centre of mask looks dark like a face hole; spill barely visible
